social_circle.name: Denise Froneberger

demographics.occupation: Dental office front desk and billing administrator
demographics.education: High school diploma with some community college coursework and dental office insurance training

Questions about gas money, grocery needs, and whether Beulah can drive Eli somewhere.
Checking in about Beulah's stress, sleep, allergies, and whether counseling might be affordable.

social_circle.name: Kenzie Whitaker

demographics.education: High school diploma; some community college art coursework

shared_activities: private emotional support during deadline stress
recent_text_topics: Beulah's portfolio review stress and the next smallest tasks she needs to finish.
Coffee plans, sketchbook photos, and whether either of them is procrastinating.
Political explainers, race and policing conversations, and local candidate information.
Running jokes about Beulah's messy desk, late-night art panic, and calling TikTok 'rest.'

Asking for rides or whether Beulah can help with an art assignment.
Movie or casual game plans after dinner.
Sibling jokes about Beulah's art supplies taking over the house.
